title: 第302章 杀猪了
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

太阳落山，窒息的高温终于有了一些缓和。

窝在农家小院里的田曼琪一行人，不再一动不动地躺在地上，开始行动起来。

田曼琪缓缓撑起上半身，热得头痛，她敲了敲发昏的脑壳，道：

“今天开始大家轮流做饭，两人一组，一组一天。”

众人也知道，要是谁都不动，那谁都吃不上饭，只能是默认了田曼琪的决定。

不过今天的几具尸体已经有了些淡淡的腐烂臭味。

“把尸体拖去大河边，洗干净熏一熏再拿回来。”

田曼琪皱着眉，目前只有这个办法了。

若是不及时处理，这肉明天就彻底不能吃了。

今天吃了这肉，肠胃能不能扛得住，还尚不可知。

就着夕阳的余光，人们拽着尸体的脚踝，一步一步拖到后山，又从后山绕到大河边。

后山不在山洞的视野范围内，从这里走不会被山洞里的居民发现。

到了大河边，所有人都渴得不行了。

人们趴在河边又是一阵猛灌。

但今天的水量比昨天还要少，喝了一嘴的泥沙。

田曼琪带头将河水中间刨了个坑，这样能取些清澈的水。

她又命令大家找来柴，堆成一堆，点燃。

尸体上的肉割成一块一块，架在火堆上烘烤。

肉块上的脂肪在火的炙烤下发出浓郁的香气。

田曼琪咽了咽口水，往后退了几步。

香是香，但火堆太热了，再烤下去，她马上就要窒息了。

40多人全都站在火堆不远处的地方监督着，生怕有人不注意偷藏起肉块。

一部分人拿着刀分割尸体，一部分人不断把肉块架在火堆上烤着。

她们今天要处理好所有的肉食，保证这些食物能保存得更久些。

油脂与火焰的碰撞，向来会激发出诱人的香气。

几十块肉一起烤，香气霸道浓烈，即便是在大河边，香气还是传进了下洼村里。

下洼村的居民们下午的时候就醒了，只不过天气太热，一直都只在山洞里活动。

这会儿太阳落山，人们纷纷外出劳动。

一出洞口，大家就闻到了空气中似有若无的烤肉香气。

人们都多久没吃过肉了，一闻到这味道，口水就疯狂分泌。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The sun sets, and the suffocating heat finally eases somewhat.

Tian Manqi and his group, who were nestled in the farmyard, no longer lay motionless on the ground and began to take action.

Tian Manqi slowly raised her upper body. She had a headache due to the heat. She knocked her dizzy head and said:

"Starting today, everyone takes turns cooking, in pairs, one group for one day."

Everyone also knew that if no one moved, no one would be able to eat, so they could only acquiesce in Tian Manqi's decision.

However, several of today's corpses already had a faint smell of decay.

"Drag the body to the river, clean it and smoke it before bringing it back."

Tian Manqi frowned, this was the only way at the moment.

If it is not processed in time, the meat will be completely inedible tomorrow.

I don’t know yet whether my intestines and stomach can handle this meat after eating it today.

In the afterglow of the setting sun, people dragged the corpse by its ankles step by step to the back mountain, and then around from the back mountain to the river.

The back mountain is not within the sight of the cave, and you will not be discovered by the residents of the cave if you walk from here.

When we arrived at the river, everyone was very thirsty.

People lay down by the river and drank heavily again.

But the amount of water today is even less than yesterday, and I drank a mouthful of sediment.

Tian Manqi took the lead in digging a hole in the middle of the river to get some clear water.

She also ordered everyone to find firewood, pile it into a pile, and light it.

The flesh from the corpse was cut into pieces and roasted on the fire.

The fat on the meat gives off a rich aroma when roasted by the fire.

Tian Manqi swallowed and took a few steps back.

The incense was fragrant, but the fire was too hot. If it continued to bake, she would suffocate immediately.

More than 40 people all stood not far from the fire to supervise, for fear that someone would accidentally hide the meat.

Some people cut up the corpse with knives, while others kept roasting the pieces of meat on the fire.

They have to process all the meat today to ensure that the food can be preserved longer.

The collision of oil and flame always inspires an alluring aroma.

Dozens of pieces of meat are roasted together, and the aroma is overbearing and strong. Even by the river, the aroma still spreads into Xiawa Village.

The residents of Xiawa Village woke up in the afternoon, but the weather was too hot, so they only stayed in the cave.

The sun is setting now and people are going out to work.

As soon as they came out of the cave, everyone could smell the vague aroma of barbecue in the air.

People haven't eaten meat for a long time, and when they smell this smell, their saliva starts to secrete like crazy.
